nextAfterW1.name: Canonical Deal inventory allocation from the existing Auction award
acceptance: One existing PrismaDealRepository transaction creates the canonical Deal and one exact inventory allocation linked to the same lot binding, winning bid and award; no parallel Deal or stock engine.
Winning quantity is server-derived from the awarded bid and pinned Inventory profile/unit identity; browser stock or verification fields are not accepted as authority.
Partial winning quantity allocates only the exact winning quantity and conserves the unallocated reservation remainder without falsely committing, shipping, accepting or selling it.
Revoked seller or buyer authority cannot receive a replayed success; missing allocation, audit, outbox, award or actor evidence rolls back Deal creation completely.

Application runtime, seed, SET ROLE and legacy definer paths cannot insert an application Deal without the required inventory allocation; privileged historical migration fixtures remain explicitly isolated.
RLS overlay, one-deal reset and DR restore preserve the bound-reservation guard and stock conservation.
